description:
About Shiftbase 

At Shiftbase, we build workforce software that helps people get work done. Thousands of teams across Europe rely on our platform every day to plan work, track time, and manage leave, freeing them from unnecessary admin so they can focus on what matters and what sparked their business. 

As we continue to grow in customers, usage and product ambition, the demands on our platform grow with us. Our backend needs to scale in quality, reliability and speed of change . That’s why we’re investing heavily in modernising our platform, building a foundation that allows us to move faster, deliver better experiences, and support the next phase of Shiftbase’s growth. 

About the role: 

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you are a key driver of both product delivery and platform modernisation. You work on the core of our backend, improving reliability, performance and scalability, with the explicit goal of turning Shiftbase from a platform people enjoy into a platform they love. 

You help evolve a mature monolithic codebase into a more modular, testable and future-proof architecture. By modernising the foundation of the product, you directly enable better user experiences, faster iteration and higher overall product quality. 

What you'll do 

Drive technical excellence 

- Design and deliver high-quality, scalable solutions for complex features and system components 

- Make informed architectural decisions that balance pragmatism with long-term vision 

- Set the bar for technical craft through your contributions and code reviews 

- Own complex technical initiatives from design through production, breaking them into testable increments 

Build for reliability and scale 

- Define comprehensive testing strategies for complex features, championing quality within the team 

- Debug and resolve complex issues across multiple components, improving system observability 

- Apply security best practices throughout the development lifecycle 

- Contribute to monitoring, alerting and system health improvements 

Enable team growth 

- Mentor engineers with targeted technical guidance and feedback 

- Support onboarding and enable a collaborative, knowledge-sharing environment 

- Help shape delivery practices and improve team velocity through data-informed decisions 

What we're looking for 

Core technical expertise 

You have deep backend engineering experience with complex, high-scale systems. We don't expect expertise in everything listed below. We value engineers who've built depth and breadth through genuine curiosity and a drive to solve real problems. These are examples of competencies that matter in this role: 

- Modern PHP & architectural patterns : Experience with hexagonal architecture, domain-driven design, or similar patterns that emphasize domain modeling over framework magic. You can build maintainable systems without relying on framework shortcuts. 

- SQL & database design : Comfort writing raw SQL (not just ORM abstractions) and working with complex relational schemas particularly around time-sensitive data like scheduling, timesheets and payroll where integrity and performance are critical. 

- Legacy modernisation experience : You've gradually evolved mature systems rather than pursuing big-bang rewrites. You know when to modernize strategically vs. leaving working code untouched, and understand the balance between progress and stability when serving thousands of customers. 

- Monolith to services : Experience breaking down monoliths with good judgment about when distribution solves real problems (deployment bottlenecks, team autonomy) vs. when it adds unnecessary complexity. 

- Testing in legacy contexts : Practical experience with unit and integration testing, particularly incrementally improving coverage in existing systems. 

This might be your dream job if… 

✅ You enjoy modernising a mature platform and turning legacy code into something you’re proud of 

✅ You get energy from breaking down a monolith and shaping a more modular, service-oriented architecture 

✅ You care about product quality , not just “shipping code”. 

✅ You like improving reliability, performance and developer experience as much as adding new features 

✅ You enjoy working closely with product and frontend to make better technical and product decisions 

This probably isn’t your dream job if… 

⛔️ You only want to work on greenfield projects and avoid legacy systems altogether 

⛔️ You’re uncomfortable refactoring existing code or making incremental improvements 

⛔️ You prefer being handed fully-defined solutions rather than helping shape them 

⛔️ You’re looking for a role where architecture decisions are already “done” 

⛔️ You’d rather optimise locally than care about the end-to-end product experience

title: wo-stage onderzoek milieukosten m.b.v. bestaande afval- en emissiestatistieken
description:
wo- afstudeerstage/praktijkstage, vanaf februari 2027 

Ben jij die nieuwsgierige onderzoeker die energie krijgt van data, duurzaamheid en nieuwe inzichten?
Wil jij een inhoudelijke bijdrage leveren aan de statistieken van het CBS? 

Dit is jouw uitdaging 

Het kabinet wil dat Nederland in 2050 volledig circulair is. Om te kunnen volgen of we die doelstelling halen, is betrouwbare informatie nodig over onder andere afval en emissies naar water. Het CBS verzamelt en publiceert deze gegevens voor bedrijven. Daarbij maken we vooral gebruik van gegevens uit het elektronisch Milieujaarverslag (e-MJV), aangevuld met enquêtes. 

Naast de hoeveelheid afval en wateremissies brengen we ook de milieukosten van bedrijven in kaart, bijvoorbeeld de kosten voor afvalverwerking en voor het lozen van afvalwater. Hiervoor wordt nu een aparte enquête gebruikt. Maar is dat eigenlijk wel nodig? 

Tijdens je stage onderzoek je of we de milieukosten voor afval en wateremissies kunnen berekenen met gegevens die al beschikbaar zijn. Je combineert bijvoorbeeld gegevens over de hoeveelheid afval en geloosd water met bestaande indicatoren, zoals gemiddelde kosten per ton afval en sectorspecifieke kosten per kubieke meter geloosd water. 

Je gaat onder andere: 

- bestaande data en indicatoren analyseren en beoordelen op bruikbaarheid; 

- onderzoeken welke methode het meest geschikt is om de milieukosten te schatten; 

- een berekening of model ontwikkelen waarmee de kosten kunnen worden afgeleid; 

- de uitkomsten vergelijken met de beschikbare gegevens uit de huidige enquête; 

- onderzoeken hoe betrouwbaar en bruikbaar de schattingen zijn; 

- je bevindingen vertalen naar een concreet advies voor het CBS. 

Met jouw onderzoek willen we bepalen of we meer uit bestaande data kunnen halen en minder hoeven uit te vragen bij bedrijven. Als blijkt dat de milieukosten betrouwbaar kunnen worden berekend, kunnen de uitkomsten bovendien worden gebruikt om de bestaande afval- en waterstatistieken te controleren. 

In het meest gunstige scenario kan de aparte enquête naar milieukosten gedeeltelijk of helemaal vervallen. Dat betekent minder administratieve lasten voor bedrijven, efficiënter gebruik van beschikbare data en mogelijk betrouwbaardere statistieken. 

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag 

We verwelkomen je binnen de sector Leefomgeving bij team Milieu. Met 20 gedreven professionals werken we aan milieu gerelateerde statistieken en doen we onderzoek naar actuele thema’s zoals klimaat(verandering) en circulaire economie. We werken nauw samen met andere teams binnen het CBS. 

We werken hard aan het continu verbeteren van onze statistieken en de cijfers beschikbaar te stellen voor het publiek. Voorbeelden van recente publicaties uit ons team zijn: 

- Bedrijven investeerden in 2024 minder in milieu | CBS 

- Bijna 2 procent meer bedrijfs- en industrieafval in 2021 | CBS 

- Milieukosten en -investeringen van bedrijven | CBS 

Dit breng jij mee 

Je volgt een wo-opleiding milieukunde, economie, technische bestuurskunde, data science of een aanverwante opleiding. 

- Je hebt affiniteit met het onderwerp circulaire economie. 

- Je bent analytisch sterk en kunt complexe vraagstukken gestructureerd onderzoeken en vertalen naar heldere inzichten. 

- Je kunt goed programmeren in R. 

- Je bent sociaal en communicatief vaardig en kunt je ideeën en bevindingen helder overbrengen aan verschillende gesprekspartners. 

Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk. 

Dit kun je van ons verwachten 

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je: 

- jouw competenties in kwantitatieve data-analyse versterkt door gebruik te maken van milieustatistieken en economische databronnen; 

- jouw onderzoeksvaardigheden aanscherpt op het gebied van de circulaire economie en levenscyclusanalyse; 

- jouw programmeervaardigheden in R verder ontwikkelt; 

- ervaring opdoet met het interpreteren van verschillende datasets om betrouwbare profielen op te stellen. 

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week). 

Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken. 

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden 

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken. 
Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking.

title: Strategy & Operations Lead, Data & Intelligence
description:
GRESB is the global sustainability intelligence standard for real assets. For over 15 years, real estate and infrastructure managers have reported to us, building a dataset of 150,000+ assets across more than 2,000 portfolios. Together with Asset Impact, which tracks emissions for over 300,000 physical assets and 77,000 companies, we’re turning that data into decision-grade intelligence for investors, lenders, index providers and regulators.

We’re building a new Client & Data Intelligence organization to showcase the value of the data to investors and develop new use cases within the ecosystem. It brings sales, product and data teams together under one leader, the Chief Client & Data Intelligence Officer. This role is the person who makes that organization run. The role is based out of Amsterdam.

The Role 

You’ll work directly with the Chief Client & Data Intelligence Officer as the strategist and operator at the center of a newly formed team. Your job is to keep decisions moving, teams connected and priority work getting finished, so the leadership team can focus on clients and growth.

It’s a role for someone who can shape a problem and then see it through. One week you might be building the business case for a new data product; the next you’re tightening the sales pipeline, preparing a board update and unblocking a delivery issue between product and engineering. You’ll move between sales enablement, product and data operations, and you’ll be trusted to run several projects at once without dropping any of them.

You’ll see the whole business, from client conversations to product decisions to the CEO’s agenda, and you’ll have influence over how a new organization works.

What you will do 

Strategy and priority projects 

- Lead the organization’s highest-priority initiatives end to end, for example pricing, our investor program, entry into new markets and maturing the data strategy
- Frame the problem, build the analysis, align stakeholders and drive the work through to a decision and implementation
- Bring a recommendation, not just options
Operating rhythm and decision-making 

- Run the team’s operating cadence: weekly deal desk, fortnightly product council and monthly business review
- Own the decision log, so it’s always clear what was decided, by whom and what happens next
- Spot blockers between sales, product and data teams early and clear them
Commercial operations and sales enablement 

- Own pricing and support deal structuring with the sales team
- Keep pipeline and ARR reporting accurate and trusted, with one view across GRESB
- Work with sales and product to make sure the team has what it needs to showcase the value of the data products
Reporting and communication 

- Build and run the monthly CEO dashboard and KPI reporting
- Prepare senior leadership, board and client materials that are clear, concise and decision-ready
- Act as the Chief Client & Data Intelligence Officer’s point of contact when they’re away

What success looks like 

In your first six months

- The operating rhythm is running and people rely on it
- The decision log is live and used
- There’s one trusted ARR view across GRESB data products
By the end of your first year

- At least two priority projects have been taken from problem to implemented decision
- Leadership and board reporting runs on a predictable monthly cycle with little rework
- Sales, product and data teams describe fewer handoff issues, and escalations get resolved faster
Requirements 

- Around 6–10 years of experience
- A grounding in top-tier management consulting or Big Four advisory, in strategy, sustainability, data or technology
- Ideally, spent time at a sustainability data, ESG ratings, real asset or financial data business
- Strong business acumen and ability to work well in a cross-functional, global environment.
- Experience implementing AI or advanced analytics solutions within a commercial or sales environment.
- Proficiency in CRM, data analytics, and visualization tools.
- A working understanding of how data products are packaged, priced and sold

How you work 

- You think in structure: you can break down an ambiguous problem, find what matters and build a clear path forward
- You finish things. You run several projects at once and see each one through to the end
- You’re organized, detail-oriented and work well in systems
- You write and present clearly, whether it’s a one-page update or a board deck
- You get things done without formal authority, by earning trust across sales, product and engineering
- You’re comfortable moving between the big picture and the detail in the same day
Benefits 

- Involvement in a fast growing international data-driven company
- Opportunity to work with a highly talented and committed team in a supportive environment with strong camaraderie
- Annual leave of 25 days per calendar year
- 2 volunteering days off per year
- Company pension plan
- Free public transport to and from the Amsterdam office
- Free and healthy office lunch catered daily 
- Annual professional development budget
- Home office budget 

About GRESB 

GRESB is the global sustainability intelligence standard for real assets. We transform sustainability data into decision-grade intelligence that drives capital allocation and asset improvement.

Our vision: An investment industry that plays a central role in creating a sustainable world.

Our mission: To provide financial markets with actionable sustainability insights, data, and benchmarks. More than 100 global institutional and financial investors rely on GRESB to help guide their investment decisions, mitigating risk, improving portfolio quality, and driving long-term financial success.

The GRESB team is an energetic group of more than 100 individuals from diverse backgrounds with experience spanning sustainability, data science, software development, real estate, infrastructure, and the capital markets. Most of us work out of our head office in Amsterdam or one of our satellite offices in London, Paris, Berlin, Boston, Singapore, or Sydney. We’re passionate about tackling the sustainability challenge by providing the insights that will power the markets of the future and enable investors to allocate the world’s capital in a more responsible way.

GRESB is a portfolio company of BeyondNetZero, General Atlantic's climate investing platform.

GRESB is an equitable, diverse, and inclusive workplace, one at which all workers - regardless of their gender, race, ethnicity, national origin, age, sexual orientation, identity, education, or disability - feel valued and respected. We are committed to a non-discriminatory approach to hiring and provide equal opportunity for employment and advancement in all of our teams and programs.

ZEAL Network SE is a leading international provider of online lottery products, operating for over 20 years with brands like LOTTO24 and Tipp24. As Germany’s largest digital lottery operator and a trusted partner of Spain’s ONCE, we are passionate about shaping the future of lottery experiences.

LOTTO24 is Germany’s leading online provider of state-licensed lottery products, offering customers convenient and secure access to popular games like LOTTO 6aus49, Eurojackpot, and GlücksSpirale. As a trusted partner of the state lotteries, LOTTO24 ensures that every ticket sold helps support charitable, social, and community projects across Germany. By combining ease of play, trusted security, and meaningful social contributions, LOTTO24 exemplifies ZEAL’s vision of making lottery participation more accessible while giving back to society.

The role:

As our Senior Brand Manager, you take end-to-end ownership of bringing our brand and marketing strategy to life through impactful, large-scale consumer campaigns. You translate strategic priorities and brand challenges into concrete campaign strategies and own their end-to-end execution. Working closely with cross-functional teams, agencies, and external partners, you combine strategic thinking, creativity, and data-driven decision-making to strengthen brand positioning, drive growth, and deliver measurable business impact.

Your tasks:

• Translate brand and marketing priorities into campaign strategies, creative concepts and actionable briefs

• Collaborate closely with Media, CRM, Creative and Product teams to ensure a consistent brand experience

• Own and execute large-scale, integrated consumer campaigns across high-reach channels such as TV, online video and OOH

• Own creative development and production, managing agencies, partners and our internal Creative Studio

• Use consumer research, customer insights and competitive analysis to identify Brand challenges and opportunities

• Define campaign objectives and KPIs and optimize activities based on data, results and learnings

• Align marketing initiatives with Product, Legal and Compliance requirements

• Manage marketing budgets and ensure efficient resource allocation

• Report campaign performance and key learnings to senior leadership

What you offer us: 

• At least 5 years of in-house Brand Marketing experience for a consumer-facing brand

• Strong understanding of brand strategy, positioning and integrated consumer marketing

• Strong analytical mindset with experience using data, research and customer insights to drive Brand Marketing decisions

• Strong understanding of high-reach media channels and how they contribute to Brand and business objectives

• Proven hands-on experience owning and executing large-scale, integrated B2C campaigns end-to-end

• Strong hands-on experience in creative development and complex campaign productions, including moving image

• Strong project management skills and confidence independently driving complex projects

• Experience independently managing significant campaign and production budgets

• Experience defining campaign KPIs and measuring Brand and business impact through campaign research, brand tracking and performance data

• Professional proficiency in German, both written and spoken

• Experience in Performance Marketing, CRM or evidence-based marketing is a plus

• Experience in e-commerce and start-up or scale-up environments is a plus

What we offer:

- A modern, dynamic culture grounded in the success of a leading-edge e-commerce company.

- A talented team of ambitious, like-minded colleagues where your knowledge and ideas truly make an impact.

- Ongoing personal growth, supported by an annual development budget of €1,500 to invest in your professional development.

- Trust and autonomy, no micromanagement, just confidence in your ability to deliver and excel.

- Flexible work options with a hybrid setup focused on results.

- Unlimited vacation days in addition to your yearly 30-day vacation allowance.

- Opportunity for workations abroad using our WorkFlex tool.

- Monthly mobility allowance of €30 to use on the mobility option of your choice (e.g., the Deutschlandticket), plus access to a company bike leasing program.

- Company pension scheme, provided in partnership with Degura, to support your future financial security.

- Subsidized EGYM WELLPASS membership, with a contribution of only €25 per month, giving you access to a wide range of gyms and sports options across Germany.

- Quarterly company events, along with regular team activities and informal gatherings, a favorite being our Healthy Tuesday lunches or Treat Thursdays in the office!

title: Vice President, Product Marketing
description:
Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health. 

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

Our AI-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.

As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.

The Vice President of Product Marketing will play a pivotal role in our marketing strategy through the positioning and packaging of our products and services. They will play an integral part in shaping and executing our go-to-market strategy, driving product adoption, enabling our GTM teams, and ensuring our solutions meet the evolving needs of our customers, members and providers. This role requires a visionary leader with a deep passion for mental health, exceptional marketing acumen, and a proven track record of success in B2B environments. Our category is an increasingly competitive one and it will be your responsibility to ensure we bring differentiation to life in novel, and inspiring stories that solidify our position as the category leader.

What you’ll be doing: 

- Develop and execute a comprehensive product marketing strategy that aligns with the company's business objectives and growth targets.

- Partner closely with the CxO and broader extended leadership team to position us for future horizons and new audiences in a way that builds brand credibility and opportunities.

- Lead and develop a team of product marketers across positioning, enablement,competitive intelligence and market research, and operations to execute on our ambitious growth goals and innovation strategy.

- Conduct thorough market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities, trends, and potential threats in the mental health sector.

- Define and communicate the unique value proposition of our products, ensuring clear and compelling messaging across all channels.

- Lead the development and execution of go-to-market plans for new product launches, ensuring successful adoption and market penetration.

- Work closely with product management, sales, customer success, and other departments to ensure alignment and drive cohesive marketing initiatives.

- Leverage customer feedback, data analytics, and industry insights to inform product development and marketing strategies.

- Oversee the creation of high-impact marketing materials, including sales collateral, case studies, whitepapers, and thought leadership content.

- Provide the sales team with the tools, training, and resources they need to effectively sell and position our products.

- Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of product marketing efforts and drive continuous improvement.

- Be a thought partner and deeply embed yourself into the Revenue organization to ensure we are lockstep on strategic areas such as our sales story, our differentiators, our segment strategy, and more.

- Champion across our entire organization the voice of the market as it relates to what will attract high value prospects and ultimately grow our business.

What success looks like in this role: 

- Achieving our brand awareness goals around Share of Voice, and brand visibility

- Successfully executing on Product and Service launches in a way that drives traffic, leads, and ultimately credibility

- Ability to drive product and service adoption across our customers, while ultimately driving and supporting renewal and upsell targets

- Achieving strong product market fit in our positioning and messaging, ultimately measured by successful pull-through messaging in press, and pick up organically around our messaging

- Strong revenue organization adoption of our collateral and material, which will be measured through enablement engagement and collateral success metrics

- Strong partnership relationships with key stakeholders across the business, and team Thriving Scores that show the team is inspired, empowered and energized

What we expect from you: 

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

- 10+ years of experience in product marketing, with at least 5 years in a leadership role within a B2B environment.

- You have built or implemented AI tools that are used across multiple people or multiple teams to change the way that work is done

- Proven track record of successfully launching and managing products in a competitive market.

- Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable insights.

- Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

- Ability to think strategically while executing tactically.

- Experience working in a late-stage company or fast-growing startup is a plus.

The target base salary range for this position is $250,000-$300,000 , and is part of a competitive total rewards package including stock options and benefits. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by a number of factors including experience, location, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. title: Sales Manager – SaaS/B2B (f/m/d)
description:
UNSER PURPOSE BEI PLANCRAFT 

Gemeinsam das Rückgrat des europäischen Handwerks aufbauen – mit moderner Software und smarten AI-Lösungen. 
Wir entwickeln nicht einfach nur Software – wir haben die Mission, Handwerkerinnen und Handwerksbetrieben mehr Raum zu schaffen, indem wir sie mit einer praxisnahen SaaS-Lösung ausstatten, die so arbeitet wie sie: schnell, effizient und ohne unnötigen Admin-Aufwand. Unterstützt durch smarte AI-Funktionen genau dort, wo sie im Alltag wirklich helfen. Mit Tier 1 Investoren aus Europa und den USA wie Headline und Creandum sowie über 30.000 Handwerkerinnen als Kundenbasis skalieren wir europaweit, um aus einzelnen, verstreuten Betrieben vernetzte und erfolgreiche Communities zu machen.
Wir glauben an zero admin, nicht zero personality – und wir entwickeln jede Funktion mit den Menschen im Blick, die die Sicherheitsschuhe tragen, nicht die Anzüge. Wir haben Bock, die Zukunft zu gestalten, zusammen als Team, und sind bodenständig in unserer Mission, die Macherinnen von morgen zu unterstützen.

DEINE MISSION BEI UNS 

Als Sales Manager (f/m/d) bist du ein zentraler Treiber des Umsatzwachstums bei plancraft . Du arbeitest mit qualifizierten, eingehenden Leads und begleitest sie vom ersten Gespräch bis zum Vertragsabschluss.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten 

- Du bearbeitest qualifizierte Leads mit erkennbarem Bedarf.

- Du führst Produktdemos durch, analysierst Kundenbedürfnisse und entwickelst passende Lösungen.

- Du berätst potenzielle Kund:innen strukturiert und begleitest sie durch den gesamten Verkaufsprozess .

- Du schließt Deals eigenständig ab – vom Erstgespräch bis zum Vertragsabschluss .

- Du behältst deine KPIs im Blick und arbeitest strukturiert mit unserem CRM .

- Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing und Customer Success zusammen, um die bestmögliche Kundenerfahrung zu schaffen.

Bei plancraft erwarten dich klare und transparente Karrierepfade – z. B. von Junior Sales Manager bis Senior Sales Manager – und du kannst dich bei uns mit klarer Perspektive und nachhaltig weiterentwickeln. Unsere Gehaltsstruktur ist transparent aufgebaut: Je nach Erfahrungslevel liegt dein On-Target-Earnings (OTE) zwischen 60.000 € und 87.500 € , bestehend aus einem Fixgehalt zwischen 45.000 € und 62.500 € sowie einer variablen Komponente zwischen 15.000 € und 25.000 € .

DEIN PROFIL 

Must-haves 

- Erste Erfahrung im B2B- oder SaaS-Vertrieb , idealerweise im Umgang mit warmen Leads oder Closing .

- Erfahrung in der Bedarfsanalyse und im Führen strukturierter Verkaufsgespräche.

- Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen (z. B. HubSpot, Pipedrive oder Salesforce).

- Interesse daran, AI zu nutzen , um deinen Sales-Alltag smarter, skalierbarer und wirkungsvoller zu gestalten.

- Deutschkenntnisse auf C1/C2-Niveau .

- Offenheit, regelmäßig in unser Büro in Hamburg zu kommen (hybrid).

Nice-to-Haves 

- Erfahrung im SaaS-Vertrieb .

- Erfahrung mit Kund:innen aus dem Handwerks- oder Baugewerbe .

WARUM PLANCRAFT? 

- Team Spirit: Mit Leidenschaft, Engagement und echtem Bock setzen wir alles daran, unsere Mission gemeinsam zu verwirklichen. Team Spirit feiern wir regelmäßig: mit 3 großen Team Events im Jahr, 2 monatlichen lockeren Formaten in unserem HQ und einer starken Recognition Culture, in der wir kleine wie große Erfolge sichtbar machen und gemeinsam zelebrieren.

- Ownership: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung ab Tag eins. In einem Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und hohem Vertrauen kannst du wirklich etwas bewegen.

- Weiterentwicklung: Wir investieren gezielt in deine Entwicklung – durch eine starke Feedback Kultur, ein persönliches Learning Budget und Enablement Formate. Wir wollen dich bestmöglich unterstützen, damit du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst.

- AI Enablement: Unsere internen Tools und Workflows sind von Grund auf KI-gestützt konzipiert. Wir unterstützen jedes Team und jede einzelne Person dabei, KI im Arbeitsalltag auf dem nächsten Level einzusetzen – inklusive einer eigenen ChatGPT+-Lizenz, selbstverständlich.

- Tech & Tooling: Du bekommst moderne Hardware wie ein MacBook und hochwertige Over Ear Kopfhörer sowie alle Tools, die du für dein Daily Doing brauchst.

- Flexibilität: Ob remote, hybrid oder im Office: Du arbeitest dort, wo du es am besten kannst. Unser Hamburger Büro am Rödingsmarkt (inkl. Dachterrasse) steht dir jederzeit offen.

- Erholung: 30 Urlaubstage, der 24.12. frei, ein Zuschuss zum Urban Sports Club sowie interne Sport Meetups unterstützen dich beim Abschalten.

- Mobilität: Du kannst dir ein JobRad holen oder ein bezuschusstes Deutschlandticket bzw. eine BahnCard nutzen.

- Internationales Umfeld: Wir werden stetig internationaler mit Kolleginnen u. a. in Italien, Frankreich, den Niederlanden und Österreich – und kommunizieren intern auf Englisch.

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied AI Engineer based in Germany. 

As an Applied AI Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing and building the next generation of intelligent, agentic systems.
You will develop the core infrastructure that enables AI agents to manage context, use tools, coordinate tasks, and continuously improve their performance.
Working at the intersection of advanced AI research and practical software engineering, you will transform complex operational workflows into reliable, scalable production solutions.
You will establish robust evaluation, testing, and observability frameworks to ensure AI-powered systems deliver predictable and measurable results.
You will also explore innovative ways to integrate coding agents and specialized subagents into software development processes.
Collaborating closely with product and operational teams, you will identify high-impact automation opportunities and translate them into effective technical solutions.
As an early core member of the engineering team, you will have significant influence over architectural decisions, technical standards, and the long-term AI strategy.

Accountabilities 

In this role, you will design and implement the technical foundations of agentic systems while driving the adoption of AI-powered engineering workflows. Your responsibilities will include:

- 
Design and build essential components of agentic systems, including memory, context management, tool-calling capabilities, orchestration mechanisms, and feedback loops.

- 
Develop reusable AI infrastructure that enables new workflows to be introduced quickly, consistently, and with predictable reliability.

- 
Build comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, identify failure points, and understand the factors behind successful outcomes.

- 
Integrate testing, tracing, debugging, and evaluation into the software engineering lifecycle as fundamental practices.

- 
Develop systems and validation processes that allow agentic workflows to be thoroughly assessed before production deployment.

- 
Advance the use of large language models (LLMs) in software development by creating sophisticated AI-assisted engineering workflows.

- 
Build workflows where coding agents and specialized subagents can explore code repositories, implement changes, review architecture, validate conventions, run evaluations, and iterate with minimal human intervention.

- 
Actively use agentic engineering tools and workflows in daily development activities.

- 
Design architectures that enable specialized AI agents, tools, deterministic software, and human expertise to work together effectively.

- 
Determine when to use LLMs, traditional software solutions, human intervention, or coordinated multi-agent approaches to achieve the best outcomes.

- 
Collaborate with operational and product teams to understand existing processes, identify high-value automation opportunities, and transform them into reliable production systems.

- 
Establish scalable architectural patterns and engineering standards for agentic systems as the organization grows.

- 
Take ownership of technical decisions and contribute to the overall direction of the AI engineering function.

Requirements 

The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with hands-on experience building production-ready AI systems and the autonomy to solve complex technical challenges in a rapidly evolving environment. The following qualifications and skills are expected:

- 
Strong software engineering background, with proven experience independently delivering complex systems from initial concept through production deployment.

- 
Practical experience building and deploying AI or agentic systems that have operated in production environments.

- 
Demonstrated understanding of real-world AI engineering challenges, including reliability, latency, context management, failure modes, evaluation, and observability.

- 
Strong knowledge of agent architectures, tool use, structured outputs, context management, orchestration, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops.

- 
Advanced practical experience with modern LLMs and the ability to build reliable workflows around probabilistic AI systems.

- 
Hands-on experience using coding agents and agentic development workflows as part of everyday software engineering.

- 
Ability to break down complex engineering tasks across multiple agents or specialized subagents and implement mechanisms for validating and improving their outputs.

- 
Strong architectural judgment and the ability to select the right combination of AI models, deterministic software, and human intervention for different challenges.

- 
Experience with TypeScript and Node.js, or strong experience developing AI systems in Python combined with the willingness and ability to work in a TypeScript-first environment.

- 
High level of autonomy, ownership, and confidence making technical decisions in ambiguous situations.

- 
Strong product mindset and the ability to connect engineering decisions with operational efficiency and business outcomes.

- 
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English.

- 
Startup mentality, including resilience, adaptability, initiative, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Benefits

Early-Team Influence: Join as an early core engineering team member with significant ownership over technical direction and architectural decisions.

title: Internships & working students at Hypersonica
description:
Build what most people think is impossible.

Hypersonica is building sovereign European hypersonic capability.

We are developing technologies that sit at the edge of what is currently possible, and we are doing it with small, talent dense teams of exceptional people.

Our culture takes inspiration from the operating philosophy behind Skunk Works. Small teams. Exceptional talent. High trust. Minimal bureaucracy. The freedom, tools and responsibility to solve problems that have not been solved before.

We are looking for interns who want to work in that environment.

The Opportunity 

This is not an internship where you spend three months shadowing someone, preparing slides or waiting to be given something meaningful to do.

You will work alongside some of the best engineers and operators in Europe on real problems connected to real hardware and real programmes.

Depending on your background, that could mean contributing to areas such as:

- Engineering, propulsion, aerodynamics, structures, materials, avionics, GNC, software, electronics, manufacturing, test, quality, simulation, data or operations.

The exact problem matters less than how you approach it.

You will be given responsibility early, expected to think independently and encouraged to challenge assumptions.

If you see a better way of doing something, we want to hear it.

Who we are looking for 

We are not simply looking for the highest grades. We are looking for people with exceptional potential. People who are deeply curious. People who ask why something has to be done a certain way. People who are not restricted by what they already know, what has been done before, or what others believe to be possible.

You might be a great fit if:

- You learn extraordinarily quickly.

- You enjoy solving difficult problems with incomplete information.

- You naturally break problems down to first principles.

- You build things because you are curious about whether they can be built.

- You are comfortable being wrong, learning quickly and trying again.

- You care deeply about the quality of your work.

- You want feedback and are equally comfortable giving it.

- You can communicate clearly with people very different from yourself.

- You want responsibility rather than supervision.

- You would rather create something than inherit a finished system.

What we value 

- Mission alignment.

- Exceptional subject matter ability.

- The ability to execute in ambiguity.

- A builder mindset.

- A willingness to be on site, close to the hardware and the people building it.

- We believe in radical candour. High performing people should be able to challenge one another, give direct feedback and change their minds when the evidence demands it.

- We also believe that the strongest teams are built from different perspectives, backgrounds and ways of thinking.

What you will get 

- The chance to work on technology that very few people in the world ever get close to.

- Direct exposure to exceptional engineers and technical leaders.

- Real ownership.

- Real hardware.

- Real problems.

- A very steep learning curve.

- And, if you are exceptional, the opportunity to build a career with us after university.

Who should apply 

We are interested in outstanding students from leading universities across the Germany and Europe, including Oxford, Cambridge, TUM, LMU and others, however:

- Your university matters less than your ability.

- Your degree matters less than what you can do with it.

- Your experience matters less than how quickly you can learn.

- We are particularly interested in people who can point to something they have built, researched, competed in, broken, redesigned, coded, tested or taught themselves simply because they wanted to understand whether it could be done.

Security and Eligibility Requirement 
Due to the nature of the work we undertake, applicants must be a EU/Nato/German citizen, and be eligible for German Security Clearance.

One final thing

If you are looking for a comfortable internship with a clearly defined playbook, Hypersonica probably is not for you.

If you want to spend your internship surrounded by exceptional people trying to build technology years ahead of where most believe it should be possible, we would like to hear from you.

Come and build something that does not yet exist.

title: Senior Design Engineer | Deel
description:
Role: Senior Design Engineer

Company: Deel 

Location: United Kingdom, Israel, Portugal, Spain, Czech Republic, Poland, France, Switzerland, Hungary, Ireland, Sweden, Germany or Estonia

Job Type: Full-time

About Deel

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance and equipment management sit in one product. It supports every worker type in 150+ countries. In 2024, Deel paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits in 109 countries.

The company has a $17.3 billion valuation and reached $1 billion in ARR in just over five years. About 7,000 people work at Deel, across more than 100 countries and 74 languages. Customers rate it 4.83 on average, from 15,000 reviews on G2, Trustpilot, Capterra, Apple and Google.

Most teams use AI as a faster way for humans to build products. Deel wants to go further and build the system that lets AI build the products. Humans set the taste, the guardrails and the standards it works within.

That system is your product. You build what AI generates against: the design system and component architecture, the generation and agent workflows, the quality gates that keep output production-ready, and the feedback loops that keep it all visible to the team. You stay hands-on as a designer, because the quickest way to prove the system works is to ship real interfaces on top of it.

This is a senior individual contributor role in Product Design. You split your time between Figma and a code editor in roughly equal measure. You work directly with design leadership to drive AI adoption across the whole design organisation, and you sit in a cross-functional team with Engineering and Product.

What you are expected to do:

Build the system

- Architect the design system, tokens and components as the substrate AI generates against.

- Design prompt libraries, patterns and agent workflows that turn design intent into production-ready UI with minimal human assembly.

Prove it by designing

- Stay a practising designer. Explore concepts quickly and design real interfaces.

- Prototype in production front-end code. You are the first and toughest test of whether the system produces excellent, shippable work.

Own quality, guardrails and evals

- Define production-readiness criteria for AI-generated UI.

- Set design-to-code fidelity benchmarks, regression safeguards and evaluation methods that keep AI output honest. Speed must not cost craft.

Drive the AI workflow across the design org

- Work with design leadership to maintain, evolve and roll out the AI-native workflow across the whole design organisation, not only your own work.

- Treat it as an ongoing responsibility. Drive adoption, keep standards current as tools change, and embed the workflow across teams so it never depends on one person.

Work across functions

- Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product and design-system contributors. You complement engineering and do not replace it.

- Keep the system round-tripping to shared surfaces such as Figma. AI-accelerated output stays visible and open to feedback, never a black box.

Push into generative UI

- Take AI beyond the build process and into the product itself.

- Prototype and evaluate adaptive, AI-generated interfaces as a product capability, and help decide where they belong on the roadmap.

Level up the team

- Turn what works into playbooks, prompt libraries and enablement. The wider design org builds on the system and does not depend on you. The goal is durable capability, not tool dependency.

What you need to succeed:

- You move fluidly between design and code. You don't need to be the deepest specialist in either. You can design something well, build it yourself, and use AI to move quickly between the two.

- You have real taste for layout, typography, interaction and motion, and you care about polish.

- You are comfortable writing TypeScript and React, including HTML, CSS and animation. You prototype fast and get from idea to working interface in hours rather than days, moving between Figma and code.

- You have built or extended design systems that others rely on.

- You already use AI design and coding tools in real work, and you want to help shape new ones.

- You have 7+ years in product design and front-end engineering on complex products. You are comfortable with ambiguity, and you set standards others follow.

What you get:

- Stock grant opportunities, depending on your role, employment status and location.

- Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country.

- Optional flexible working office membership with IWG.

Krumbach-Niederraunau, Bayern · Hybrid · Vollzeit, unbefristet

Über Everfield 

Everfield übernimmt, entwickelt und skaliert europäische Softwareunternehmen aus vertikalen Märkten und Spezialnischen und gibt ihnen die Werkzeuge an die Hand, um den nächsten Schritt zu gehen. Über SoCom 

Die SoCom Informationssysteme GmbH entwickelt mit rund 45 Mitarbeitenden TIKOS, die führende ERP-Lösung für gewerbliche Wäschereien und Textildienstleister. Mit rund 40 % Marktanteil in der DACH-Region und über 30 Jahren Erfahrung steuern Kunden mit TIKOS ihre gesamte Prozesskette, von der Wäscheannahme über RFID-Tracking bis zur Auslieferung. Seit Oktober 2026 gehört auch die Düchting Software & Consulting GmbH zur SoCom-Familie. SoCom ist Teil des Everfield-Ökosystems.

Über die Rolle 

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unsere gesamte IT: die interne Infrastruktur, die Informationssicherheit und die SoCom Cloud, in der wir TIKOS für unsere Kunden betreiben. Viele dieser Leistungen haben wir bisher extern eingekauft. Jetzt holen wir das Know-how ins Haus – und du stellst die IT so auf, dass sie mit unserem Wachstum, der Integration neuer Unternehmensteile und steigenden regulatorischen Anforderungen Schritt hält.

Du bist Gestalter:in und Macher:in zugleich: Du entwickelst die IT-Strategie gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung und packst im Tagesgeschäft selbst mit an.

Deine Aufgaben 

• IT-Verantwortung und Strategie: Du verantwortest die IT von SoCom ganzheitlich, entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung eine IT-Roadmap und steuerst das IT-Budget für Hardware, Lizenzen, Cloud und Dienstleister.

• Insourcing und Dienstleistersteuerung: Du überführst bisher extern erbrachte Leistungen – Netzwerk, Firewall, Server, Backup und E-Mail-Security – schrittweise in die eigene Verantwortung. Verbleibende Dienstleister und Verträge steuerst du über klare SLAs.

• Cloud und Hosting: Du betreibst die SoCom Cloud, in der wir TIKOS für Kunden hosten, und entwickelst sie weiter. Gemeinsam mit Vertrieb und Support kalkulierst du Hosting-Angebote, verantwortest Verfügbarkeit, Kapazität und Kosten und treibst eine zukunftsfähige Hosting-Architektur voran.

• Infrastruktur und Betrieb: Du verantwortest Server, Netzwerk, Firewall, Backup und Disaster Recovery – am Standort und in der Cloud – sowie Microsoft 365, Endgeräte, Telefonie und Mobilfunk. Monitoring und Patch-Management steuerst du über ein RMM-Tool.

• Informationssicherheit und Compliance: Als interne:r Owner für IT-Security koordinierst du das Schwachstellen- und Incident-Management, arbeitest eng mit dem CISO-Netzwerk von Everfield zusammen und setzt die Anforderungen aus NIS-2, Cyber Resilience Act und DSGVO in der Infrastruktur um.

• Integration Düchting: Du bringst die IT der Düchting Software & Consulting GmbH bis 2027 auf SoCom-Standard und konsolidierst Systeme, Lizenzen und Prozesse.

• Dokumentation und Wissenssicherung: Du baust eine belastbare IT-Dokumentation auf – Systeme, Zugänge, Kosten und Notfallpläne –, damit Wissen im Team geteilt und jederzeit verfügbar ist.

• Führung und Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit unserer IT-Administration zusammen und bildest mit ihr ein Team mit gegenseitiger Vertretung. Für Support, R&D, DevOps und Vertrieb bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson für alle IT-Themen.

• KI und Digitalisierung: Du begleitest den sicheren Einsatz von KI-Tools im Unternehmen gemäß der KI-Richtlinie von Everfield und automatisierst interne IT-Prozesse.

Was du mitbringst 

Muss 

• Abgeschlossenes Studium (Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik o. Ä.) oder Ausbildung zur/zum Fachinformatiker:in mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der IT-Administration oder im IT-Management, davon mindestens 2 Jahre in verantwortlicher Rolle in einem mittelständischen Unternehmen (ca. 30–250 Mitarbeitende)

• Fundierte Praxis mit Windows Server, Active Directory/Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Netzwerken (VLAN, VPN) und Firewalls (z. B. Sophos, Fortinet)

• Erfahrung im Betrieb von Cloud- oder Hosting-Infrastruktur (IaaS, z. B. IONOS, Azure, AWS) inklusive Virtualisierung, Backup und Disaster Recovery

• Ausgeprägtes Sicherheitsbewusstsein und praktische Erfahrung im Schwachstellen- und Incident-Management

• Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer IT-Dienstleister sowie im Budget- und Lizenzmanagement

• Hands-on-Mentalität: Du übernimmst Verantwortung und löst Probleme selbst

• Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und gute Englischkenntnisse für die Abstimmung im internationalen Everfield-Netzwerk

Kann 

• Erfahrung im Hosting von Business-Software für externe Kunden (SLAs, Mandantentrennung)

• Kenntnisse in NIS-2, ISO 27001/BSI IT-Grundschutz oder dem Cyber Resilience Act

• Erfahrung mit SQL-Server-Datenbanken und Linux-Systemen

• Erfahrung mit RMM-Tools (z. B. NinjaOne, Datto RMM) und Automatisierung mit PowerShell

• Erfahrung mit IT-Integrationen nach Unternehmenszukäufen

• Kenntnisse im sicheren Einsatz von KI-Tools

Nicht jede:r erfüllt jeden Punkt. Wenn du die Muss-Kriterien weitgehend mitbringst und Lust auf die Aufgabe hast, bewirb dich – wir freuen uns, dich kennenzulernen.

Bewerbungsprozess 

• Erstgespräch (30 Min.) mit Karolina, Talent Acquisition Partner bei Everfield

• Fachinterview (60 Min.) mit Stefan Hoffmann, Geschäftsführer SoCom, und Everfield AI Lead

• Finales Gespräch vor Ort in Krumbach (90 Min.) mit Fallstudie (z. B. ein Insourcing-Plan für einen externen IT-Dienstleister) und Kennenlernen des Teams

title: Senior AI R&D Engineer – Model Training  (f/m/d)
description:
Our Mission

Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model . Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

Team Culture

At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose.

We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other.

About the Role

As a Senior AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d), you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri. 

- You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals.

- No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term.

- We're still building out our training pipeline and infrastructure. Some pieces exist, some do not, and you will have real influence on what gets built and how. Your work directly shapes how quickly we can experiment and improve our models.

- Identifying issues and taking initiative is what drives our day-to-day work.

- Working mode, design decisions, priorities are all done in your team together with your team mates. 
The strongest teams often use highly collaborative techniques, like mob or pair programming.

- Due to the highly collaborative nature of our work you are expected to be on-site at least two days a week. If you are in Berlin, you should expect to travel around every second month for a few days to Heidelberg.

- We are specifically looking to strengthen the Software Engineering in the teams which are research heavy. Major points include improving the maintainability of our code through tests and design & architecture changes.

Requirements 

- At its core, you need to be able to dive into a codebase, change the behavior as necessary, and after the change the code should be better tested and easier to understand than before.

- As such we look for candidates for an understanding of how to design for low coupling and high cohesion paired with the ability to incrementally refactor.

- Experience with the following technologies is likely to be helpful:

- Test Driven Development (TDD)

- Trunk based development

- Continuous integration

- Domain Driven Design

Nice-to-haves 

- Most of our code is in Python, there is also the occasional Rust codebase.

- Large parts of our training pipeline are built on top of Kubernetes.

- We do not hire for skills in a particular technology or language, but rather ability to learn and mindset, yet experience with these technologies is a plus.

What we offer 

- Become part of an AI revolution!

- 30 days of paid vacation

- Access to a variety of fitness & wellness offerings via Wellhub 

- Mental health support through nilo.health 

- Substantially subsidized company pension plan for your future security

- Subsidized Germany-wide transportation ticket

- Budget for additional technical equipment

- Flexible working hours for better work-life balance and hybrid working model

- JobRad® Bike Lease

title: Head of Electronics & software
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Head of Electronics & Software

Purpose

We are looking for a Head of Electronics & Software to lead and develop the engineering capability behind some of the most critical systems in our spacecraft.

This is a senior leadership role combining people leadership, engineering excellence, organisational development and technical breadth . You will lead a multidisciplinary organisation spanning:

- Avionics, communications and electrical power systems

- Flight software (FSW)

- Guidance, navigation and control (GNC)

- Electrical wiring and interconnection systems (EWIS), including harness engineering

- Future projects and advanced electronics and software development

You will be responsible for ensuring our teams have the people, skills, processes, tools and engineering standards needed to deliver ambitious space programmes today, while building the capabilities we will need for the future.

This is not a role for someone looking to step away from engineering. We are looking for a leader who can engage credibly with highly technical teams, challenge constructively, develop strong technical leaders and help create an environment where exceptional engineering can happen.

Matrix Organisation

Our engineering teams work in a matrix organisation, combining strong functional leadership with project-based delivery.

As Head of Electronics & Software, you will lead the functional organisation, developing its people and capabilities while working closely with Project Managers, Project Chief Engineers, technical authorities and engineering Leads responsible for programme delivery.

You will:

- Lead and develop Project Leads, discipline Leads, Principal Engineers and transversal engineering resources

- Partner with project leadership to align capability, resources and priorities with programme needs

- Help teams navigate competing priorities across projects

- Ensure clear ownership and accountability between functional leadership and project execution

- Build an organisation capable of supporting multiple programmes as the company grows

Success in this environment requires collaboration, influence and sound engineering judgement rather than centralising every technical decision.

Role Boundaries

This role owns the strength and effectiveness of the Electronics & Software organisation : its people, capability, engineering practices, tools, standards and functional budget.

You will create the environment in which our technical teams can perform at their best, providing mentoring, challenge and access to expertise while supporting technical and project leadership in making strong engineering decisions.

Project technical decisions and product technical authority remain within the relevant project and technical organisations. Your role is to ensure they are supported by a highly capable engineering organisation with the right expertise, methods and resources.

Key Responsibilities

People, Hiring & Organisation

You will build and shape a high-performing Electronics & Software organisation.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Owning workforce and headcount planning across the function

- Recruiting and retaining exceptional engineering talent

- Developing clear job families, role levels and assessment standards

- Partnering with Talent Acquisition, engineering Leads and hiring managers to maintain a high technical hiring bar

- Leading promotion, compensation and organisational planning within the function

- Building succession plans and reducing key-person dependencies in specialist areas

- Creating an organisation that remains lean, scalable and aligned with current and future programme needs

Line Management & Development

Developing strong engineers and technical leaders will be a major part of the role.

You will:

- Lead and develop the managers, Leads and senior engineers within your organisation

- Establish meaningful objectives aligned with project and company priorities

- Build clear development and technical career paths

- Strengthen mentoring, coaching and leadership capability across the organisation

- Create opportunities for engineers to gain experience across design, integration, test and operations

- Address performance challenges fairly and constructively

- Build a culture where progression is based on demonstrated capability, impact and organisational need

Engineering Processes, Standards & Compliance

You will help define how excellent electronics and software engineering is done across the company .

This includes:

- Owning and continuously improving engineering practices across electronics, software, GNC and electrical/harness engineering

- Establishing practical standards for electronics design, software development, testing, modelling, reviews and verification

- Ensuring teams understand and can effectively apply the relevant processes

- Supporting certification readiness, audits and continuous improvement, including applicable EN9100 requirements

- Working closely with Quality, Safety, Systems Engineering and the Chief Engineer organisation

- Using lessons from development, testing and operations to continuously improve engineering practices

Our aim is not process for process's sake. We want processes that are lean, pragmatic and proportionate to engineering risk .

Engineering Tools & Ways of Working

You will ensure our engineers have the tools and engineering environment needed to work effectively and at scale.

This includes capability across:

- Electronics and PCB design

- Harness CAD

- Software development, build and configuration toolchains

- Automated testing

- GNC analysis and modelling

- Software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop environments

- Simulation and shared test infrastructure

You will drive standardisation, adoption and good engineering practice while partnering with Digital, IT, Procurement, Quality and other engineering teams.

The goal is simple: engineering work should be efficient, traceable, reproducible and ready to scale. 

Project Support & Resource Planning

You will work closely with our projects to ensure they have access to the Electronics & Software capability they need.

You will:

- Mentor engineering Leads and provide senior technical guidance where needed

- Support major technical and engineering reviews

- Maintain visibility of capability gaps, resource constraints and significant engineering risks

- Work with project leadership to resolve resource requirements through hiring, development, internal mobility or external support

- Anticipate future capacity constraints before they become programme blockers

- Help resolve cross-project resource and organisational conflicts

- Contribute to the company-wide electronics and software strategy alongside the Chief of Engineering and CTO

- Shape future capabilities, reusable technologies, R&D priorities and obsolescence strategies

Budget

You will own the Electronics & Software functional budget and forecast, including:

- Headcount and personnel planning

- Engineering tools and licences

- Relevant shared simulation and test capability

- Training and development

- Functional team travel

You will work closely with Finance, Procurement, Digital and project leadership to ensure investment supports both immediate programme needs and longer-term engineering capability.

Requirements

We are looking for someone who combines credible engineering depth with proven organisational leadership .

You should bring:

- Strong hands-on engineering experience in at least one of the following: avionics, electronics, embedded systems, flight software, GNC or electrical systems

- Enough technical breadth to operate effectively across several of these disciplines and understand how they interact

- Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams in a complex product environment

- Proven formal line-management experience, including developing managers and technical leaders

- Experience hiring, developing and building engineering organisations

- Experience with organisational design, workforce and capacity planning

- Experience creating or improving engineering processes, tools, standards and ways of working

- Experience operating within a matrix organisation and supporting multiple projects or programmes

- Strong coaching, mentoring, communication and influencing skills

- The technical credibility to challenge senior engineers while empowering the appropriate technical owners to make decisions

- A pragmatic approach to engineering quality, assurance and compliance, including relevant EN9100 practices

Experience in spacecraft, launch vehicles, aerospace, defence, aviation, robotics or another complex safety-critical engineering environment would be particularly relevant.

We are looking for a leader who: 

- Leads with high standards, humility and low ego

- Enjoys developing people rather than simply directing them

- Empowers strong technical Leads and avoids becoming a bottleneck

- Can challenge experienced engineers constructively

- Makes decisions using data and sound engineering judgement

- Balances immediate programme pressures with long-term organisational capability

- Creates clarity where responsibilities cross organisational boundaries

- Promotes transparency, accountability, collaboration and continuous learning

- Believes in extreme ownership and engineering first principles 

- Remains close enough to the engineering to understand the challenges our teams are solving

Location & Travel

This is a leadership role with teams and stakeholders across our European organisation, so regular face-to-face engagement is important.

You should expect to spend time across our main European sites, with additional travel where required for team leadership, recruitment, major engineering reviews, audits and project support.

- We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind

About the Role 

Hi there! We're hiring an Enterprise Account Executive GCC to join our Sales team in UAE.

Our sales team is tenured, technically curious, and genuinely invested in doing right by the customer. We partner closely across the business, and we operate with a lot of trust: you're given real ownership over your territory, and you're expected to bring your own judgment to how you build it.

This role gives you a book of enterprise accounts to grow and a real say in how you build your territory. You'll work complex, multi-stakeholder deals, and you'll have the backing of sales engineering and customer success behind you as you build credibility and close.

As an Enterprise Account Executive II, you'll own the full sales cycle for a defined set of enterprise accounts, from first conversation through negotiation and close, partnering with sales engineering, customer success, and your manager to navigate complex deals. This role matters because enterprise wins are how Camunda grows its footprint in large accounts, and how we prove the platform works at scale.

What You Will Do 

- Build a territory plan that identifies land opportunities and expand possibilities, leveraging extended resources like partners, marketing, and customer success.

- Build account plans that identify whitespace, map stakeholders, and set a realistic path to close.

- Navigate multi-stakeholder buying committees, including technical, business, and economic buyers.

- Own and execute the full sales cycle, from prospecting through negotiation and close.

- Partner with sales engineering and customer success to build technical credibility and ensure a smooth handoff and adoption after close.

- Manage pipeline and forecast with discipline and accuracy.

What You Will Bring to the Role 

- Must have proven product sales experience in Oman, Qatar

- Must have proven experience in outbound sales and pipeline generation.

- Solid experience closing enterprise software deals end-to-end, with a track record across multiple full sales cycles. You know what it takes to move a deal from first meeting to signature without losing momentum.

- Comfort navigating multi-stakeholder enterprise environments. You've worked complex deals involving IT, business, and procurement stakeholders, and you know how to keep everyone moving in the same direction.

- Developing territory and account planning instincts, with the ability to orchestrate resources efficiently. You can build a plan with some independence, not just work from a list handed to you.

- Comfort selling technical products. Experience with process automation, integration platforms, middleware, or similar technical software is a real advantage, since you'll regularly be in the room with engineering and IT buyers.

- Negotiation experience under real pressure. You know where to hold firm and where to flex, and you can explain your reasoning either way.

- A relationship-building style that goes beyond the transaction. You've had customers start to treat you as an advisor, not just a vendor.

- Ability and/or willingness to use our product .

About the role: 

ProcessOS is a new kind of Camunda product: business processes described in natural language, generated as executable BPMN workflows, and improved autonomously from production data. We’re hiring the first cohort of Forward Deployed Engineers to bring it into production at enterprise customers. You’ll own the deployment journey from first process file to a working, improving system, and hand off a functioning capability to the customer’s team. The code you write and the patterns you discover feed directly back into how ProcessOS is built. This is a rare opportunity to shape a product, a function, and a field practice from day one.

You’ll work end‑to‑end across Java services and React interfaces, collaborating closely with a talented global team to measure, improve, and scale performance and fault tolerance in real-world distributed systems.

What You’ll Be Doing: 

- Deploy and prove. Own the journey from first process file to production workflow. At 90 days: at least one workflow running, the improvement loop active, and measurable fitness gains the customer can see. At 12 months: 3–5 customers with viable deployments.

- Drive organizational adoption. Work across technical and business stakeholders to build understanding and trust, turning early deployments into lasting customer capability.

- Work at depth technically. Configure and run Camunda clusters locally and in cloud environments. Debug integration failures. Build custom agents where platform defaults don’t fit. Write connector logic that gets legacy enterprise systems talking to ProcessOS.

- Build the playbook. There is no deployment template yet. Document what good looks like as you discover it, and make the next implementation faster.

- Feed the product. Custom agents you write get contributed back. Integration patterns get codified. Production bugs you find, you often fix. Your field work is a direct input to ProcessOS.

- Hand off deliberately. Leave customers with a team that can operate independently, is trained on the platform, and acts on improvement results without you.

What You Will Bring to the Role 

Must Haves: 

- Enterprise production experience: you’ve shipped something inside a large organization and stayed to see it operate. You know why governance and resilience matter at scale.

- Technical depth: You can debug an integration failure, write a custom agent against a legacy API, stand up a Camunda cluster from scratch, and explain generated BPMN to both engineers and business leads.

- Stakeholder communication: you work effectively across engineering, architecture, and business leadership and adapt how you communicate without losing precision.

- Practical AI experience: you’ve used AI to solve real problems in production – not just experimented. You understand context management, prompt engineering, agent testing, and integration tradeoffs.

- Comfort with ambiguity: you make sound judgment calls without a playbook and document what you learn.

- Occasional travel may be required

Nice to Haves: 

- Experience in a customer-facing engineering or professional services role.

- Familiarity with regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or insurance

- Production experience with agentic systems or AI-integrated workflows.

- Contributions to a shared platform or open source project that others built on.

title: (Senior) Performance Marketing Manager (all genders)
description:
Holidu is one of the world’s fastest-growing holiday rental technology companies. Our mission is to make booking and hosting holiday homes free of doubt and full of joy, by helping hosts generate more bookings with less work and helping guests find a holiday home they truly enjoy. Our team of 700 colleagues from 60+ nations shares a passion for tech, an ambition for constant improvement, and a relentless drive to bring the best experience to more than 40k holiday rental hosts and 4 million annual guests.

Your future team 

You will be part of the Paid Search team, the growth engine of Holidu's Performance Marketing: we run Google Ads and Microsoft Ads across all Holidu domains and brands in Europe, on both sides of the marketplace - Guest (B2C, bookings) and Host (B2B, lead generation). We are a small, international and highly analytical team: value-based bidding at scale, our own bidding infrastructure, and data-driven in every decision. We work AI-first, and we are early: as marketers, we build our own analyses, automations and internal apps with LLM tooling (mainly Claude), together with our MarTech team. The team is led by Andreas, who has two decades of experience in digital marketing, and you will work closely with Rasmus, one of Holidu's Co-Founders.

What you will do 

This role suits a proactive builder: strong numerical mindset, comfortable creating structure where none exists yet, at home in both strategy and hands-on execution.

- Own large-scale Search Engine Advertising across multiple European markets (Google Ads and Microsoft Ads), from account structure to value-based bidding that grows efficiently

- Challenge how we do paid search today: question our bidding logic, structures and processes, and bring perspectives we have not considered. With us, arguments and data weigh more than job titles

- Co-build internal marketing apps with Claude Code and GitHub, as a marketer, not an engineer. We are first movers here: you will learn a skill almost nobody in the market has yet, and you will shape our tooling together with our MarTech team

- Own your numbers end-to-end: find the improvement potential others walk past, run high-impact A/B tests across large budgets, decide with data, and turn results into playbooks instead of one-off learnings

- Pilot what is next in paid search: AI Max, the first generation of LLM advertising (OpenAI/ChatGPT Ads), and AI-powered workflows from anomaly detection to statistical analysis

What you bring 

- A sharp, quantitative mindset and strong analytical thinking: you make decisions with data, spot what others miss, and can argue your case clearly

- Ownership of business results: you think in outcomes, not processes, and build solutions rather than wait for instructions

- Hands-on experience in paid search (Google Ads; Microsoft Ads as a plus): trajectory and depth of thinking matter more to us than years

- Genuine curiosity about AI in marketing: you’ve already used AI tools to change how you work, not just to draft texts, and want to go deeper. No engineering background needed, curiosity is the requirement

- Fluent English (our working language); any additional language is a plus

What we offer 

- Impact : Make a difference for hundreds of thousands of monthly users.

- Growth : Take responsibility from day one and develop through regular feedback, workshops, and knowledge exchanges.

- Personal Development : Use your learning budget and 2 extra study days for conferences, books, courses, and more.

- Community : Engage with international, diverse, yet like-minded colleagues through regular events and 2 office days per week with your team.

- Flexibility : Benefit from our hybrid work policy and the chance to work from other local offices for up to 8 weeks a year.

- Fitness : Get a premium gym membership at a discounted rate.

- Travel : Enjoy 28 vacation days + 13 public holidays in Bavaria and the possibility to take up to 10 unpaid vacation days with special discounts on our Holidu Homes properties.
